pages.title: Heavy Company
pages.text: Meet the advanced riding helper through its actual vehicle behavior.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Obtain the golem through its native construction route. Gold and lava are separate native modifications with their own tradeoffs; neither is required for this goal.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Mount the Netherite Golem and use jump to attack; gold ingots add piglin-neutral trim and lava unlocks coal summons. The mount gains specialized combat utilities; lava augmentation adds water vulnerability.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Mounted jump triggers the native attack. Gold trim affects Piglins; lava enables coal summons but adds water vulnerability. Apply real native upgrades, not a pair of unverified item clicks.
